cancel.beforePaid.text: The professional is not on the way yet, so cancelling is free. You get a full refund of {refund}.

cancel.beforeFree.text: The professional is not on the way yet, so cancelling is free. You have not paid anything yet.

cancel.afterRefund.text: The professional is already on the way. The travel fee of {fee} applies, and {refund} comes back to you.

cancel.afterNoRefund.text: The professional is already on the way. The travel fee of {fee} covers everything you paid, so there is no refund.

cancel.afterNothing.text: The professional is already on the way, but you have not paid anything yet, so there is nothing to refund.

cancel.noRefundBody.text: The job was cancelled. There is no refund because the travel fee covers your payment.

cancel.pro.late.text: You are already on the way. Cancelling now lowers your FIXX Job Quality Score. The customer can choose a replacement or a full refund.

cancel.pro.early.text: The customer can then choose a replacement or a full refund.

choice.title.text: What would you like to do?

choice.body.text: Choose a replacement and your payment of {paid} carries over. You see any price difference before you confirm. Or take a full refund.

quote.carryMore.text: Your earlier payment of {paid} carries over. You pay {difference} more now.

quote.carryCovered.text: Your earlier payment of {paid} carries over and covers the deposit of {deposit}.

resched.intro.text: Changing the time is free until the professional is on the way. The current time stays booked until it is accepted.

resched.pending.text: Waiting for the professional to answer by {when}. Your current time stays booked until then.

resched.declined.text: The professional declined the new time. Your current time stays booked, or you can cancel for free.

resched.pro.body.text: The customer asked to move the job to {when}. Please answer by {deadline}.

addl.payout.text: Your payout for the additional work

addl.invalid.text: Add a description and a payout greater than 0.

addl.pro.waiting.text: Waiting for the customer to approve the additional work.

addl.pro.unpaid.text: The customer must pay the additional work before you can mark the job complete.

addl.card.text: It is added to your balance and charged after the job is complete.

addl.cash.text: You pay it with a reference. The job cannot be marked complete until it is paid. There is no separate deposit.

notif.reschedule.requested.text: The customer asked to change the time. Please answer within {rescheduleHours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.

notif.reschedule.requestSent.text: Your request was sent. Your current time stays booked until the professional accepts.
